kills.property: Depositing a positive nonzero amount must succeed (not revert) when called with any value > 0.
kills.change_summary: Replace the require check with one that will fail when adding value would not overflow (inverts the condition), preventing most deposits.

kills.property: If a caller deposits a positive even or odd amount, the contract's stored balances for that caller increases by the depo
kills.change_summary: Insert a conditional that only updates balances when msg.value is an even number, otherwise skip the update (so some deposits don't change balances).
